name: A Feast for Buzzards
summary: A battered skeleton on the plains bears marks that may tell a hunter what happened. You bring its skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar for her judgment.

sections.title: A Skull on the Plains
sections.body: The bones lie battered beneath the sun, their pale surface marked with shapes like teeth and claws. The damage leaves the victim unknown. You carry the skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar, where a hunter may read what the marks reveal.

faq.answer: Its limbs bear marks resembling teeth and claws, but the attacker remains unclear.

faq.q: Why bring the skull to Neza?
faq.answer: Neza is a hunter at Rog'mar who may recognize what the markings mean.
The skeleton is badly damaged, and its identity is unknown before Neza examines the skull.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Feast for Buzzards
